name: Wavering Text
description: Text that wobbles as if drawn by hand, or wavers as if seen through moving water, using an SVG displacement filter.

props.name: children
props.description: The text. It stays real text: selectable, searchable and read as is.

props.name: mode
props.description: Boil steps through a few fixed filter frames like hand-drawn animation. Ripple changes the turbulence continuously for a slow underwater waver.

props.name: steps
props.description: Number of frames in a boil.

props.name: stepDuration
props.description: Milliseconds each boil frame is held.

props.name: baseFrequency
props.description: Turbulence frequency. Lower values give broader, smoother waves.

props.name: as
props.description: The element to render, e.g. "h1" or "p".

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the element. Other props are passed through. The filter pauses off screen and holds one frame under reduced motion.
